 Order
Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India challenging order dated 18.12.2020 passed in Case No.8761/B-121/2020- 2.

Counsel appearing for petitioner submitted that impugned order has been passed by S.D.O. under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation,
and Resettlement Act, 2013 and he has no jurisdiction to pass such an order.

sentences.text: 3. Government Advocate appearing for State is unable to deny the proposition put forward by the petitioner.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is clear that S.D.O. has no jurisdiction to pass an order under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Collector has to refer the matter to competent authority for deciding the reference in accordance with law.
5. Considering the aforesaid, writ petition is allowed and order dated 18.12.2020 passed in Case No.8761/B-121/2020-21 is quashed.
Matter is remanded back to Collector for passing orders in accordance with law.
6. No opinion is expressed on the merits of the case.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
